source_summary: Tall vertical Chinese landscape with layered green-brown mountains, misty valleys, winding water, small village and pavilion groups, bridges, pines and foreground groves. Seals and inscriptions are excluded.

motifs.name: central_terraced_peak
motifs.description: Isolate the dominant upper-center mountain mass with arcing terraced ridges, dark dotted vegetation bands, pale ochre-green washes, and mist-softened right edge.
must_preserve: dark ink-dot vegetation along crest bands
soft fading mist edge on the right side
small pine clusters on lower ledges

motifs.name: left_cascading_mountain_slope
motifs.description: Isolate the large left-side descending mountain slope that steps from mid-height into the lower valley, including its repeated rounded ridges and vertical pine strokes.
must_preserve: small pine and shrub marks embedded along the slope
rocky ledges at the lower edge

motifs.name: right_cliff_village_slope
motifs.description: Isolate the right mid-ground cliff and hillside with small roofed buildings, thin pines, rocky outcrops, and descending path-like terraces beside the water.
must_preserve: thin dark pine trunks and sparse needles

motifs.name: central_lake_village_banks
motifs.description: Isolate the middle water basin with pale horizontal water washes, low banks, tiny riverside houses, tree rows, and narrow landing-like strokes.
must_preserve: blank pale water surface with light horizontal wash lines
small roof forms along both banks
subtle warm ochre accents near the water

motifs.name: pine_retreat_on_mid_knoll
motifs.description: Isolate the compact retreat or pavilion cluster nestled among pines on the central-lower rocky knoll above the water bend.
must_preserve: dense pine needles and upright trunks
pale green washes between tree clusters
fine architectural linework kept separate from surrounding mountains

motifs.name: lower_left_water_bridge_bend
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left winding river bend with a simple bridge, small waterside pavilion or roofed structure, low banks, and sparse trees.
must_preserve: thin bridge linework and vertical supports
small roof geometry on the bank
scattered tree trunks and bamboo-like strokes

motifs.name: foreground_right_pine_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the prominent foreground grove on the right: tall pines and leafy trees rising from rocks, with layered needles, blue-green foliage dots, and exposed trunks.
must_preserve: long pale tree trunks with ink outlines
overlapping shrubs and grasses at the base

motifs.name: bottom_rocky_foothill_ridge
motifs.description: Isolate the bottom foreground ridge and rocky foothill forms with rounded striated mounds, dark brush texture, sparse shrubs, and the adjacent pale stream edge.
must_preserve: patches of green wash on mound tops
pale stream boundary at the lower right

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
